name: Quiet Editorial
summary: A calm magazine spread: serif headline and still life on one side, the product in use on the other.
works_for: Anything sold on taste: jewelry, watches, skincare, candles, leather goods, fine stationery.
default_colors: warm ivory and soft sand with deep brown type
prompt:
Create a 2:3 vertical editorial advertisement for {{BRAND}}, featuring {{PRODUCT}} (category: {{CATEGORY}}).

Composition: a soft vertical split. The left 60% is a calm surface of {{COLORS}}, with a curved shadow falling across it. The right 40% is a tightly cropped, real-looking photograph of the product from Image 1 in use: on the body if it is worn, in a hand if it is held, or on a beautiful surface if it is neither. If a person appears, crop so that the face is not shown, and dress them in soft camel wool.

Headline: upper left, a refined high-contrast serif in deep brown, on two lines, reading exactly: "{{HEADLINE}}". Beneath it, one very fine short gold line.

Supporting line: small, light and airy under the line, reading exactly: "{{SUBHEAD}}".

Still life: in the lower left, the product from Image 1 rests on soft fabric or stone with a gentle contact shadow, shown large enough to read every detail.

Brand: the logo if supplied, otherwise the name "{{BRAND}}", very small, at the bottom left.

Call to action: small understated text beside the brand, reading exactly: "{{CTA}}".

Finish: quiet natural window light, gentle shadows, true-to-life materials, generous empty space. Nothing glossy, nothing shouted.

copy_brief.style: Quiet, assured, few words, no exclamation marks.
copy_brief.headline_note: An understated quality, not a command.

motion_prompt: Soft window light drifts slowly across the surface and the product gives a single delicate glint. The camera barely moves. All text stays perfectly still and legible.
